messages:
marta: Promo to prod blocked, deploy-bot failed fetching blobs from regional cache (eu-west) for build 2026.04.02-rc2. Change window in 22m.

leo: Seeing repeated lease evictions in the logs: 
`cache_client: lease_evicted key=blob:sha256:5c3a... attempts=4 status=504`

cheng: Artifacts verified at origin, checksums match when fetched directly. So not corruption, likely cache regional instability or overload.

deploy-bot: promote-job-3312: failed_step=fetch-blob error=lease_evicted job_state=FAILED

marta: Options: (A) wait for cache to stabilize (risking missing window), (B) pin prod to previous rc1 and abort promote, (C) force origin fetch and re-run promote (we haven't used that flow in prod before).

leo: For safety and speed, pin to rc1. We can re-promote rc2 after cache infra confirms stability.

cheng: Agree. Minimal blast. No DB migrations in these builds.

marta: Commands: 
```
# pin prod to previous image for release window
deployctl route pin --env=prod --image=sha256:113f... --reason="cache lease evictions"
# abort the stuck promote job
deployctl job abort --id promote-3312
```

leo: I'll run the abort if you do the pin.

marta: Pin complete: prod now pinned to 2026.04.01-rc1 sha256:113f... :white_check_mark:

leo: Aborted promote-3312 :ok_hand: deploy-bot confirms.

ci-bot: Post-pin smoke checks: auth/search/write OK, p95 within SLO.

release-mgr: Release window preserved. Opening INC-2026-210 for artifact-cache lease evictions in eu-west; will coordinate re-promote playbook and add a line to release notes explaining temporary pin to rc1.

cheng: I'll hand the cache logs to infra and schedule a controlled re-promote after validation. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
